message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) from the lexicon based on the fact.

Fact: The defendant signed a contract to lease land (23.26 acres) for a rice cooperative. From May 2013 to May 2014, he built warehouses, drying facilities without proper land use permits. The land is farmland (耕地). The authorities issued notices to stop illegal behavior, but he continued. He occupied 14.79 acres of cultivated land illegally. This is illegal occupation of farmland.

The lexicon includes "非法占用农用地" (illegal occupation of agricultural land). That matches.

Also possibly "非法转让、倒卖土地使用权" (illegal transfer/sell of land use rights) but here he didn't transfer or sell, just occupied. So only "非法占用农用地".

Thus answer: [罪名]非法占用农用地<eoa>

We need to follow format: [罪名]非法占用农用地<eoa>

Thus:

{
 "reasoning": "The defendant built facilities on cultivated land without permits, continuing after notices, which constitutes illegal occupation of agricultural land.",
 "final_answer": "[罪名]非法占用农用地<eoa>"
}
